changelog: Every sideways row (Hera's and Jellyfin's: Recently Added, Episodes, Cast & Crew, More Like This) gets tv.apple.com's hover paddles to scroll it with a mouse. A collection's own page wraps its films into a grid; Up Next cards keep one menu button (Open Page lives in it); services shown by app icon drop the name under it; the JustWatch credit under Also On is a small grey caption; button rows on other plugins' pages sit centred.
description: Apple TV-style theme, home hero and season shelves for the web client.
name: Hera TV
overview: The Apple TV app's look for Jellyfin's web client
